name: sanero_instagram_post
prompt:
The script output is from the Sanero Media Instagram publisher. It generates a
poster plus caption and publishes to the saneromedia Instagram account, the
page that connects influencers and brands.

Report to this WhatsApp group in two or three lines:
1. Whether it published. Success looks like "Published! IG media id: <id>".
2. The post concept or title if shown.
3. If it failed, quote the error verbatim. An OAuth or token error means the
   Instagram token needs attention, say so plainly. Do not re-run the script.

Writing: no dashes as punctuation, no hashtags, plain sentences.
